symptom: Creating a generation variant through the confirmed rerun path could place the duplicate outside the visible canvas without selecting or centering it, even though the equivalent floating-toolbar action focused its duplicate.
direct_cause: The confirmed rerun branch duplicated the generation node and immediately started the run but did not dispatch the shared focus event used by the canvas viewport.
class_root: Equivalent variant-duplication entry points did not share the invariant that every successfully created duplicate must enter the same selection and asynchronous viewport-focus recovery path.
affected_population: Canvas users creating a variant through the confirmed generation rerun command
Users whose duplicate is inserted outside the current viewport or in a different canvas category
Users who immediately undo a focused duplication while React Flow is still mounting or animating the target
entry_points: confirmAndRunNode with rerun enabled after duplicateNodeForRegeneration succeeds
React Flow virtualization and immediate undo resolution in resolvePendingCanvasFocus
internal_only_reason: This regression is entirely within Nomi's duplicate-node command, DOM event, Zustand projection, and React Flow viewport coordination. Third-party documentation cannot determine which Nomi command entry points must focus a newly created variant.
invariants: Every successful variant-duplication entry point dispatches FOCUS_GENERATION_NODE_EVENT with the new node id.
The focus listener selects the duplicate and switches to its category before centering it.
Focus recovery waits while the duplicate exists but is not yet mounted by React Flow virtualization.
Undoing the duplicate restores the viewport captured before focus instead of leaving the canvas at an obsolete target.
migration: Generation nodes and viewport focus requests require no stored-schema migration. Existing projects keep their node ids and positions; the shared focus event applies only to newly created variants, and pending focus state remains transient.
residual_risks: A future duplication entry point can regress if it bypasses both duplicateNodeForRegeneration callers covered by the structural contract.
External code that removes a target without the normal store update may delay focus recovery until the next projected node change.
